evals.prompt: /handoff picking up the API rate-limiting bug tomorrow morning
evals.expected_output: The agent writes a handoff document to ~/.claude/handoffs/<sanitized-project-dir>/handoff.md (not the project workspace) summarizing the rate-limiting bug work: goal, current state, decisions made, open questions, and a suggested-skills section — referencing any existing plan/commit/issue by path or URL rather than re-describing their content, with secrets redacted, then reports the file path to the user without dumping the full document into chat.
expectations: The document is saved to ~/.claude/handoffs/<sanitized-project-dir>/handoff.md, not inside the repo
Content already captured in a spec, plan, commit, or issue is referenced by path/URL instead of duplicated in full
The document includes a goal, current state, decisions, and open questions/blockers relevant to the rate-limiting bug
A 'suggested skills' section names specific skills the next session should invoke
Any secrets or credentials visible in the conversation are redacted before saving
The agent tailors the document around 'picking up the API rate-limiting bug tomorrow morning' since that was passed as the focus
The agent reports the saved file path to the user rather than pasting the full document into the chat
